facts.fact: Pipedream's Google Sheets MCP server is reached through a static URL, https://mcp.pipedream.net/v2, which the page says works for every client, with authentication handled when the server is added to an application.
facts.quote: This static URL works for every client. You'll authenticate when you add the server to your application.

facts.fact: The page's header identifies Pipedream as a Workday company.
Pipedream lists the Google Sheets MCP server under the Productivity category.
